tools.name: ebay_sold
tools.description: Search one page of eBay sold listings by keyword, on eBay US or seven other countries. A page holds up to 200 rows with count=200, or 40 without it. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/do

tools.name: ebay_listings
tools.description: Search one page of eBay active listings by keyword, on eBay US or seven other countries, in the sort order you pick. A page holds up to 200 rows with count=200, or 40 without it. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free.

tools.name: poshmark_sold
tools.description: Search one page of Poshmark sold listings by keyword, on Poshmark US or Canada. Pages use a cursor. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/poshmark-sold

tools.name: poshmark_listings
tools.description: Search one page of Poshmark active listings by keyword, on Poshmark US or Canada, in the sort order you pick. Pages use a cursor. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/poshmark-lis

tools.name: mercari_sold
tools.description: Search one page of Mercari US sold listings by keyword, up to 100 rows. Pages use a cursor. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/mercari-sold

tools.name: mercari_listings
tools.description: Search one page of Mercari US active listings by keyword, up to 100 rows. Pages use a cursor. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/mercari-listings

tools.name: depop_listings
tools.description: Search one page of Depop active listings by keyword, from sellers in the US, UK, Australia or Canada, up to 100 rows. Pages use a cursor. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/depo

tools.name: whatnot_listings
tools.description: Search one page of Whatnot Buy It Now active listings from sellers in the US or Canada, up to 24 rows. Prices are seller asks. No sold search. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api

tools.name: tcgplayer_search
tools.description: Search TCGplayer products by keyword; returns catalog identity, source market-price estimate and a few active seller asks. Cached 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/tcgplayer-search

tools.name: tcgplayer_sales
tools.description: Fetch an exact product’s recent individual sales. Anonymous source access has shown at most five rows; this is not a complete sales history. Cached 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/tcgplayer-sales

tools.name: offerup_listings
tools.description: Search one page of OfferUp US active listings near a ZIP code or point, about 50 rows. Prices are seller asks. No sold search. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/offerup-listing

tools.name: offerup_item
tools.description: Fetch one OfferUp listing by ID or URL: description, posted date, condition, coordinates, shipping, photos, seller and vehicle details. Status is the seller-set state, not a verified sale. Cached 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs:

tools.name: facebook_listings
tools.description: Search Facebook Marketplace US active listings near a ZIP code or point, up to about 24 rows. Prices are seller asks. No sold search. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/facebook

tools.name: facebook_item
tools.description: Fetch one Facebook Marketplace listing by ID or URL: description, condition, posted date, approximate coordinates, delivery and photos. Status is the seller-set state, not a verified sale. Cached 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs:

tools.name: vinted_listings
tools.description: Search one page of Vinted active listings by keyword, on Vinted US, UK or 24 European sites, 96 rows a page. Prices are seller asks. No sold search. Results are cached for 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/do

tools.name: vinted_item
tools.description: Fetch one Vinted listing by ID or URL: description, condition, brand, size, colour, category, photos and the seller's rating. Status is not a verified sale. Cached 15 minutes. Each completed search costs 1 request, cache hits included; failed searches are free. Docs: https://soldgraph.com/docs/api/v

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Finish a search that was still collecting when its tool call returned. Free: it never charges again.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Your plan, requests used in the rolling 30 days or of the one-time free credit, remaining allowance, extra requests and rate limit. The same numbers the API enforces. Free.

tools.name: api_status
tools.description: Live health, success rate and response time for every marketplace. Free.
